newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CAGLIARI SACK URUGUAYAN COACH PEREZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAGLIARI SACK URUGUAYAN COACH PEREZ.

text.p: Serie A side Cagliari sacked their Uruguayan coach Gregorio Perez on Monday and were poised to replace him with veteran trainer Carlo Mazzone, the Italian news agency ANSA reported.

It said club chairman Massimo Cellino telephoned Perez, to tell him that he had been dismissed after only a few months. Officials at the club, third from bottom with four points, were not immediately available for comment.

Newspaper speculation that Perez was on his way out reached fever pitch after Cagliari lost 2-1 away to Lazio on Sunday. Lazio won despite playing with 10 men for almost the entire match after goalkeeper Luca Marchegiani was sent off.
ANSA said Perez would meet reporters at the club later on Monday for a final news conference.
Mazzone is a former coach of AS Roma, Ascoli and Cagliari.
